title: RunnerResult
description: Generic runner provenance and outcome envelope shared across dispatch scripts and future engine adapters.

status.description: Outcome status for the dispatched role.

runner.description: Runner family or transport identifier (e.g. codex, agy, anthropic-compatible).

model.description: Model identifier passed to the runner.

containment.description: Teardown-hygiene provenance tier when cgroup containment was attempted.

contained.description: Whether teardown verified an empty worker cgroup.

error.description: Human-readable error detail when status is not a success path.

run_id.description: Observability run identifier correlating the final JSON with the start-time run manifest (dispatch-status.js --run <id>).

usage.description: Token usage parsed from the harness event stream by dispatch-status.js (--usage-only) — never worker self-report. Null when the runner's log format carries no usage signal.

wall_secs.description: Wall-clock seconds from dispatch start to final JSON emission.
